title: Drop-marker transduction
statement: For a Boolean list $w$, the drop-marker operation is the list produced by applying the transducer with transition rule that emits nothing on a false input and emits the input value on a true input, starting from the state false. The transition function used by the transducer is not specified in the provided statement.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a list of Boolean values
caveat: The definition depends on the unspecified transducer transition function dropTr.
